candidate.title: SSB-Seq
candidate.scope: The SSB-Seq row of the assigned Illumina poster: isolated genomic DNA containing single-strand breaks is labeled by nick translation, purified and randomly sheared, then enriched by anti-digoxigenin immunoprecipitation to yield DNA for sequencing-library preparation. The adjacent TC-Seq, Ig-seq/Rep-Seq/MAF and BLESS rows and the right-hand chemical drawing are context, with no material-flow connection to SSB-Seq. The primary paper resolves the labeling substrate, chain-length restriction, capture mechanism and readout interface; its DSB-Seq workflow, etoposide application, controls and detailed library-preparation recipe are outside this depicted route. The graph ends at the poster's final DNA product; subsequent library preparation and sequencing are described as its paper-supported interface.

states.label: Genomic DNA containing single-strand breaks
features: The row labels the target 'Single-strand break' and the workflow input 'Genome DNA'; the duplex cartoon has an interruption in one strand.
The primary implementation starts with isolated high-molecular-weight genomic DNA.
A free 3'-OH at a break is required for the depicted DNA polymerase I labeling; blocked or damaged 3' termini are not made labelable by any operation shown here.

features: The row ends with a short duplex labeled 'DNA' after the antibody-capture illustration.

Enrichment reports successful labeling and antibody recovery, not complete recovery of all biological SSBs or an intrinsically Top2-specific molecular tag.

operations.label: DNA Pol I, dU-digoxigenin, and dNTPs
operations.description: Nick-translate the isolated genomic DNA, changing labelable nick-associated DNA into DNA bearing digoxigenin-modified nucleotide patches. DNA polymerase I is the catalyst and the nucleotide mixture supplies the incorporated label; neither is a separate sample branch.
operations.mechanism: DNA polymerase I performs nick translation from a suitable free 3'-OH using dNTPs including digoxigenin-labeled dUTP. The paper resolves the diagram's 'dU-digoxigenin' shorthand as an incorporated modified nucleotide and reports dideoxynucleotides to inhibit excessive chain extension.
operations.information_effect: A detectable chemical tag becomes covalently associated with DNA near a labelable break. The tag carries break association, while the surrounding genomic sequence carries locus identity. Blocked 3' ends require processing outside this route before they can be detected.

operations.label: DNA isolation and random shearing
operations.description: Recover the already labeled genomic DNA and fragment it, changing long labeled DNA into a mixture of shorter duplexes that includes label-bearing fragments. Preserve this combined block as depicted.
operations.mechanism: The paper reports purification after nick translation followed by sonication. Thus the post-labeling 'DNA isolation' caption denotes recovery of DNA that was already isolated before labeling; the two boundaries are consistent with the primary workflow.
operations.information_effect: Break-proximal labels remain on a subset of fragments, carrying nearby genomic sequence into the selection step. Fragmentation does not create a sequence tag at the original nick, so fragment ends cannot be read directly as exact break positions.

operations.label: Immunoprecipitate with anti-digoxigenin antibody
operations.description: Select digoxigenin-bearing DNA from the sheared mixture using antibody-mediated capture, then recover the enriched DNA represented by the terminal 'DNA' icon. Antibody binding and subsequent DNA purification are retained within this broad enrichment block.
operations.mechanism: Anti-digoxigenin antibody binds the incorporated hapten; the poster shows a Y-shaped antibody on a gray support with labeled DNA nearby and pale unselected fragments. The paper identifies recovery of immunocomplexes with Protein G-Sepharose beads and purification of DNA from those complexes. Antibody/support attachment is an intermediate capture state within this operation, not a sequenced product.
operations.information_effect: Selection increases representation of DNA linked to incorporated digoxigenin. The paper connects purified selected DNA to Illumina library preparation and sequencing: those reads report genomic regions associated with labelable breaks, subject to labeling and capture biases. Library preparation is an external interface here; no adaptor chemistry or PCR sequence is assigned from the poster's final colored ends.
